hubTrigger.claim: Overall July exports fell 14.5% in USD terms while automobile exports grew 118.5%, exposing a major structural divergence inside weak trade.

causalNeighborhood: Rapid automobile export growth consumes scarce ro-ro/PCTC capacity; if capacity is tight, freight economics can improve for direct operators and create order demand for car-carrier newbuilds.

validation.claim: International ro-ro demand was strong, market rentals repeatedly hit records and space was hard to secure; company increased foreign-trade ro-ro capacity to five vessels and opened Gulf/Red Sea/Thailand routes.
Ro-ro segment revenue RMB867m, +7.44% YoY; segment net profit RMB126m versus RMB9m, +1304.76%.
Lack of ro-ro capacity and congestion caused delays of three months or more and pushed some vehicle exports into containers.
